name: mirage
text: Fixed in code, not released yet. Cause: the engine has been stopped since 12:58 (your STOP), and parlay legs were only graded on the engine, and only 3 h after tip-off (the card already says 'game over' at ~2.2 h). Now the app grades finished legs itself from final scores whenever it sees one without a result, and the wait is 2 h. Florida State's legs should flip to graded once the app has this version. The parlay's own settled/paid status still comes from Novig's ledger via the engine, so that line updates when the engine runs again. I'll bundle this into the next release.
